findings.summary: When options.encoding is set it is used without checking the client's Accept-Encoding header, so clients that did not request that encoding (identity, no header, or only deflate) still get a compressed body with Content-Encoding set.
The deno_dist copy has the same bug: options.encoding bypasses the Accept-Encoding check, so unrequested compression is applied.
The substring match on Accept-Encoding via accepted?.includes also matches 'gzip;q=0', which means the client refuses gzip. The reviewer says this is not a regression.
